resources.name: Standard physical constants (m_e, e, ħ, σ)

access.notes: Electron mass m_e = 9.10938356e-28 g, elementary charge e = 4.8032047e-10 esu, reduced Planck constant ħ = 1.054571817e-27 erg·s. Surface tension of liquid helium σ = 0.37 dyn/cm. Values are public and can be hardcoded.
Optional; the analytic formulas require only basic arithmetic and standard math functions.
